title: B2B Email List Building: How to Get Contacts for Any Campaign?

facts.fact: The article 'How to Get Contacts for a Cold Email Campaign?' was published by Cleverviral on September 25, 2023.
The page lists an estimated reading time of 8 minutes.
According to the page, WhoIs.com is a domain search engine, and a prospect's email can sometimes be found under its 'Registrant Contact' section.
facts.quote: you can find the prospect’s email under the **‘Registrant Contact’** section.

facts.fact: The page says that when registering a domain, people sometimes do not share their emails publicly, so the WhoIs method is not failure-proof.
facts.quote: When registering for a domain, people sometimes don’t share their emails publicly.

facts.fact: The page names Hunter.io, RocketReach and RevDriver (by Salesintel) as browser extensions for finding prospect contact details, and says some also surface phone numbers and firmographic and technographic data.
facts.quote: some of these tools also help you source their phone numbers and other firmographic and technographic data.
